name: neon-snake-analytics-functions
description: Firebase Functions analytics backend for Neon Snake.

scripts.test: pnpm run sync-shared && vitest run test/unit
scripts.test:integration: pnpm run build && firebase emulators:exec --only functions,firestore --project demo-neon-snake "vitest run test/integration"
scripts.emulators: pnpm run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-neon-snake
